issues.element: KPI row: 'Total tokens 98K' sits beside 'Reported input tokens 3.5B' and 'Reported output tokens 14.5M'; the 'total' is smaller than its parts and nothing says why
issues.fix: Say what the total covers, e.g. rename to 'Total tokens · measured events' or add the sub-line 'Events with full usage only'; or add the 'Counters can overlap; do not add them together' note (already on Tokens & Cache) to Overview.

issues.element: 'By provider · Reported output tokens' bars show 12.5K per provider while the 'Reported output tokens' KPI on the same screen shows 14.5M
issues.fix: If the breakdown covers a different subset (e.g. per-event attributed only), say so in the card title ('… · attributed events'); the same metric name must not show two unrelated magnitudes.

issues.element: Token trend at phone width: three violet lines (solid/dashed/dotted) on a 270px plot overlap into an unreadable tangle; dash patterns are not distinguishable at that density
issues.fix: Below ~600px show one series at a time with a small segmented switch (Total / Output / Cache-read), or stack three small-multiple sparkline charts each with its own range.

issues.element: Token trend plots 'Total tokens' as its primary (solid, left-axis) line, but the Tokens & Cache KPI row has no 'Total tokens' card
issues.fix: Add a 'Total tokens' KPI as the first card on this tab (matching Overview), so the chart's main line has a headline number.

issues.element: Cost column: 'Unavailable' is rendered in the same white/semibold as real values like '$0.00', so missing data reads as data
issues.fix: Render missing values in muted grey regular weight (as already done in the Performance-unknown breakdown cards 'Unavailable'), or show '—' with the reason ('Unpriced') as the sub-line.

issues.element: Header says '128 retained events' but the table shows 3 rows with only 'Page 1' and Previous/Next — the reader cannot tell how many pages or which rows are shown
issues.fix: Show 'Showing 1–3 of 128' next to the pager and 'Page 1 of N'.

issues.element: Sub-line 'Usage presence reported' repeated under every token value (and wrapping to two lines at 1440); column header 'Details' duplicates every row's 'Details' button
issues.fix: Drop the per-row sub-line when it is the normal case and only annotate exceptions (e.g. 'Usage not reported'); blank the 'Details' header or make it visually hidden.

issues.element: Three-row table leaves ~45% of the fold empty below the card
issues.fix: Use a larger default page size (e.g. 25 rows) so the table fills the viewport.

issues.element: Notes card second line 'Legacy cache-write lifetime unavailable' (jargon, no full stop) and KPI sub-line 'Partial' with no reason
issues.fix: Rewrite as 'Cache-write cost for older events isn't priced, so totals may be low.' and change 'Partial' to 'Partial · 28 unpriced events excluded'.

issues.element: KPI cards are 650px wide with the cost sparkline pushed to the far right and Priced/Unpriced cards showing only a flat line; notes card takes a full row for two short lines
issues.fix: Cap KPI card width (or keep the 8-column grid with empty slots) so number and sparkline sit together; fold the notes into a single line with a 'Measurement details' disclosure like Tokens and Performance use.

issues.element: Unit stated twice: 'Estimated cost · USD' label with '$1,547.35' value; 'Duration trend · ms' title and every legend item '· ms'; durations shown as '2,400' ms while tokens use compact '98K'
issues.fix: Keep the unit once per element: drop '· USD' where the value has '$', drop '· ms' from legend items when the title has it; format durations ≥1,000 ms as seconds ('2.4 s') to match the compact style of other KPIs.

issues.element: Two explanatory lines under every chart ('Lines use separate scales…', 'Hover or focus a time…') repeat on every chart on every tab
issues.fix: Keep the scales/gaps sentence only on dual/triple-axis charts and move the hover hint into the chart's accessible description or a single page-level hint; single-series charts need only 'Gaps are unmeasured periods.'

issues.element: Flat sparklines (Failed events red line, Cache-write, Reasoning, Priced/Unpriced) draw a full-width straight line at mid-height, which reads as 'constant non-zero rate'
issues.fix: When a series has no hourly variation or too few points, omit the sparkline or draw dots at bucket values; never draw a level line implying data that isn't there.

issues.element: KPI cards at 1024: Estimated cost sparkline drops below the number while neighbours keep it on the right; 'p95 execution duration · ms' wraps to two lines and pushes its value up out of line
issues.fix: Pick one internal card layout per breakpoint (number left, sparkline right or sparkline beneath for all) and shorten the label to 'p95 duration · ms'.

issues.element: Mobile chart x-axis has only '12:00 · Oct 29 · 12:00' — the two '12:00' ticks are ambiguous
issues.fix: Label the first tick 'Oct 28 12:00' (or add the date to both ends).

issues.element: View tab 'Tokens & Cache' wraps to two lines in the 3-column tab grid; KPI labels wrap ('Retained / events')
issues.fix: Use a 2-column tab grid below 360px or shorten to 'Tokens'; allow KPI cards a single column below 360px.

issues.element: 'p95 reported TTFT · ms · mixed methods' — TTFT not spelled out, 'mixed methods' unexplained in the card/chart; KPI sub-line 'No range total; hourly values below'
issues.fix: Title 'p95 time to first token (ms)'; put 'Providers measure this differently' as the chart's sub-line; replace 'No range total' with 'No total for this range'.

issues.element: Empty charts say 'No measured values in this interval.' — no reason, and 'interval' conflicts with 'range' used elsewhere; 'View data table' still offered on an empty chart
issues.fix: 'No durations were reported for this range — providers did not send timing data.' Hide 'View data table' when the series is empty.

issues.element: Error body 'not configured or is temporarily unavailable. Check the server dataset binding, then retry.' — ambiguous cause and jargon with nowhere to go
issues.fix: Show the actual cause returned by the server (e.g. 'Dataset path not set' vs 'Dataset locked'), name where to fix it ('Config Panel → Analytics dataset') and link there.

issues.element: Card 'Retry' (white filled, the only filled button on the page) duplicates toolbar 'Refresh' and header refresh icon; filters/time range remain enabled with nothing to filter
issues.fix: Keep one retry action (card Retry) styled like the toolbar Refresh, and disable the toolbar Refresh/filters while in the error state, as the loading state already does for Refresh.

issues.element: Time-range pills, bucket pills and 'All outcomes' stay enabled on Model Rates even though the banner says these are current rates, not historical
issues.fix: Disable or hide time range, bucket and outcome controls on Model Rates (keep provider/model filters).

issues.element: 'current configured rates' said in both the reference banner and the table caption; header 'Rate details' repeats each row's 'Rate details' disclosure; billing cell 'Not reported / unavailable'; warning 'registrations may be incomplete' gives no next step
issues.fix: Merge banner and caption into one line; blank the column header; use 'Not reported'; add 'Sync the model catalog in AI Providers' to the warning.

issues.element: Card title 'Model Rates' is Title Case while every other card title is sentence case ('Usage trend', 'Cost trend'); 'Offline synthetic source' capitalised mid-sentence
issues.fix: Use 'Model rates' and 'offline synthetic source'.

issues.element: Empty notice says 'Choose a longer range to look further back.' but offers no action; failed-events sub-line 'of 0 events'
issues.fix: Add a 'Show last 7 days' button in the notice; replace 'of 0 events' with no sub-line when the denominator is 0.

issues.element: Below the KPI row the page is blank (no chart frame), so the empty state looks broken rather than empty
issues.fix: Keep the Usage trend card frame with its axes and an inline 'No events in this range' message, matching how the unknown state keeps empty chart frames.

issues.element: Toolbar 'Apply' now uses the same muted grey text/surface as the disabled 'Clear filters', so it reads as disabled
issues.fix: Give Apply the same enabled styling as 'Refresh' (white bold text, lifted border) when the search box has text, and a clearly disabled style when empty.

regressions: Selected segment labels (views, time range, bucket) lost their bold weight versus r14; the lifted grey surface alone is subtler, so the current selection is less obvious at 2293 and 3440 (all screens).
'Apply' lost its light filled treatment from r14 and now looks identical to the disabled 'Clear filters' (all screens, 1366/1440/2293).

No data-presentation regressions found: charts, legends, axis keys, and gap handling are unchanged from r14; Performance removed the area fill under p95 duration, which is neutral to slightly clearer.
reference_gaps: Search needs an explicit 'Apply' button; the reference searches inline with a placeholder listing searchable fields ('request ID, model, API key, account, provider, request path, or failure'); Prox's 'Model or request reference' is narrower and vaguer.

Filters are native <select> elements with OS chevrons and bold white text, not the reference's styled dropdown buttons; search and filters share one row instead of the reference's full-width search row above an even filter row.
Refresh lacks the reference's auto-refresh/interval indicator, and Prox adds a second refresh icon in the page header, so there are two refresh affordances.
No 'Show advanced filters' disclosure; the reference keeps secondary filters behind it.
At 1280 and narrower, 'Clear filters' and 'Refresh' collapse to icon-only buttons and 'Current bucket' disappears, unlike the reference where the right-hand cluster keeps labelled buttons.
